lines.en: I'm a cocoon. I can't walk.
When the wind blows, I sway twice.
I hang from the leaf's underside.
Silk holds me fixed in place.
The leaf sways, and I sway with it.
I'm getting heavier bit by bit.
The leaf vein bears my weight.
I'm slowly stretching out.
At night I listen to the wind.
I turn over inside my cocoon.
This thread is strong.
I stay still on the leaf.
Rain runs off the leaf's edge.
I turn slowly with the leaf.
There's a bug crawling below.
My silk tightened a little.
I wait beneath the leaf for wings to form.
Inside the cocoon, I can't see out.
Is it bright out there?
Time passes slowly.
I'm turning into something else.
The silk is stretched just right.
Rain can't reach this spot.
One leaf is my whole room.
I'm curled up inside.
A bit cramped, but fine.
I hear something crawling.
Lines have appeared on the shell.
Don't stare at this cocoon.
I'm only a cocoon.
Don't flick me with your finger.
Touch me and the silk loosens.
I can't see you.
But I can hear you breathing.
Are you waiting for me to come out?
Don't pick me off the leaf.
The underside of this leaf is perfect.
I will emerge.
We'll talk then.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我旁边的叶上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the leaf beside me.
You're so close and I can't see you.
A few more days is all.
One thread broke; my cocoon hangs crooked.
The cocoon dented.
Don't squeeze me, please.
I'm swaying badly.
It hurts inside.
I nearly fell.
Don't touch it; my cocoon is not yet hard.
A thin crack splits my cocoon.
I'm still hanging here.
One more touch and I come apart.
I cocooned on a leaf — don't move me.
There's no mouth in here.

lines.zh: 你在外面举什么，与我无关。
lines.en: Whatever you're holding, it's not for me.
The leaf is all I need.
Food won't lure me.
I'm not even moving.
That smell is too far away.
Talk to me when I emerge.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶下，不吃也不喝。
lines.en: I hang beneath the leaf, eating and drinking nothing.
I'm waiting for something else.
You bumped the leaf.
I swayed for a long time.
The silk nearly snapped.
Don't shake this tree.
You knocked me crooked.
I pressed tighter to the leaf.
Your hat touched me.
The leaf and cocoon moved together.
I slowly sway back.
Don't stand under the tree.
I'm not an adult yet.

lines.zh: 这种时候，没有什么好谈的。
lines.en: There's nothing to discuss at this stage.
Wait until I emerge, then we'll speak of company.
It's quiet in the cocoon.
I'm not even fully formed.
You're asking too soon.

lines.zh: 叶子上另一只已经空了。
lines.en: Another cocoon on this leaf is already empty.
The night wind passes through the seams.
Silk has wrapped me tight.
I just stay like this.
The silk holds me fast; I cannot move.
My legs are inside the cocoon.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，够不着我。
lines.en: What you hold can't reach me.
I'm just hanging on the leaf.
Don't push it at me.
This silk blocks everything.
It's hanging on the branch beside me.
I see it. That's all.
Put it back.
I have no use for it.
I have nothing to lock onto.
I can't even tell direction.
I can feel you moving.
But I don't chase.
The cocoon stays here.
I'm waiting for the moment I emerge.
Nothing else matters.
I shifted a little inside.
There's a sound outside.
It's my own wings growing.
I hang in place without moving.
You're walking about under the tree.
I feel that gust of wind.
The leaf turned half around.
Your voice is farther away now.
I went quiet again.
This shell hasn't split yet.

lines.zh: 我知道自己会破壳而出。
lines.en: I know I will break out of this shell.
It's getting crowded in here.
A while longer is enough.
I can't move at all.
I have no teeth and no claws.
Hit me, and a few threads fall.
The cocoon is soft.
If you want me dead, it's quick.
If you draw my silk, I'm gone.
I seal myself in further.
This shell doesn't protect me.
You should still go.
I only want to finish quietly.
An egg hatched on the leaf.
From a caterpillar, I became this.
I spun this silk myself.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶背下面的角度。
lines.en: I hang at the underside's angle.
This leaf suits me.
The wind spun me once.
Now there's only waiting.
I won't be noticed.
The leaf's color hides me.

lines.zh: 平原和湿地的叶子上，都有我们。
lines.en: On plains and wetland leaves, we're everywhere.

lines.zh: 火苗碰到丝，一下子就焦了。
lines.en: Fire touched the silk and it scorched at once.

lines.zh: 从叶子上掉下去，我摔在草丛里。
lines.en: I fell from the leaf into the grass.

lines.zh: 水把茧泡透了，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water soaked the cocoon and I sank.

lines.zh: 气浪把叶子和茧一起掀开。
lines.en: The blast tore the leaf and cocoon away.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿透了茧壁。
lines.en: Something sharp pierced the cocoon wall.

lines.zh: 光透进茧里，我的身体发烫。
lines.en: Light pierced the cocoon and my body grew hot.

lines.zh: 我不进食，只是慢慢变轻。
lines.en: I don't feed. I only grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷打在这棵树上，茧都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning struck this tree, and the cocoon shook.
The silk can't hold. I'm falling.
